calculation.description: Contrarian five-day asset return, amplified during rising-VIX regimes and attenuated otherwise. Both asset and VIX inputs are lagged to use only completed bars before the forecast day. VIX is observation-only and never traded.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate IC and ICIR across 2020-2026; strongest in 2022 and 2024, weaker but positive in 2023, 2025, and 2026. Conservative interpretation is required because signal coverage is about 50% due to macro alignment and available bars.
validation.deprecation_reason: Original validation artifact used unlagged inputs; correctly lagged revalidation failed admission gates (IC -0.0001310, ICIR -0.0002948).
